name: reactllm-sdd
description: Spec-Driven Development for React — one TOML spec compiles to a red Vitest + React Testing Library suite plus an implementation brief.
//: This CLI only emits test SOURCE as strings; it never imports React or a test runner. The APP that consumes the generated suites supplies those (jest or vitest, ts-jest/jest-environment-jsdom or the vitest equivalent, and @testing-library/{react,user-event,jest-dom}). They are listed under peerDependencies as documentation — install them in the consuming app, not here.
